measurement: fitted against observed MACROSCOPIC pKa, an aggregate the microscopic training labels do not contain
source: Dwar-iBond rows grouped by parent molecule; 186 polyprotic molecules whose ladder produced exactly as many steps as were observed
form: dpKa_i = -W * sum over OTHER sites j of q_j / d_ij, with d the through-bond distance
note: 1/d, plain Coulomb. Fitting 1/d^1.5 and 1/d^2 as well moved the fitting-set MAE the wrong way (2.326 -> 2.351 -> 2.422) for a marginal gain on four validation molecules, so no exponent was added.

validation.set: twelve polyprotic molecules with trusted reference values
